name: C++
summary: C++ the way game-dev and university courses teach it: types, strings, decisions, loops, vectors, references, maps and classes, ending with tower-defence turret logic (targeting and cooldowns) you can carry into Unreal. Graded by real tests.

levels.name: Basics: types, input, strings, decisions, loops, vectors, references, maps, classes
Memory: pointers, new/delete, smart pointers, RAII
Objects in depth: inheritance, virtual functions, templates, the STL
Games: Unreal C++ (actors, components, Tick), maths for games
Algorithms and data structures in C++
Professional craft: CMake, debugging, profiling, testing
Capstone: a real game system or tool, then a defense

certs: C++ Institute CPA (entry level) covers Levels 1-3
Unreal Engine's free learning paths (dev.epicgames.com) for Level 4
